thread:
elaine_cs: FYI we're getting a spike in support tickets from new signups saying they never received the onboarding invite email (verify/setup link). Started ~08:10 UTC. Customers stuck in "awaiting verification" and can't finish onboarding.

marta_support: collecting sample emails and ticket IDs. so far 37 distinct tenants, mostly EMEA trials. uploading CSV to drive when ready.

rachel_ops: infra telemetry shows outbound mail error 421/Throttling from our primary SMTP pool since 08:08 UTC. Looks like a provider rate-limit after an automated warm-up job ran at 07:55 and overshot.

ben_infra: confirming. primary pool returned 421 4.7.0 RateLimit. Switching to fallback SMTP pool now and queuing immediate resend for pending invites.

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-20260330-05  Onboarding invite email delivery failures. Bridge: https://bridge/INC-20260330-05

elaine_cs: draft outbound for impacted customers (short):
```
Hi <customer>,
Were investigating a delay preventing onboarding invitation emails from arriving between ~08:0808:30 UTC. You may see "awaiting verification" in the console. We're resending invites now and no action is required on your part. We'll follow up with an ETA and a resolution summary by EOD.
```

amanda_acctmgr: prioritizing enterprise customers for manual resend + AM outreach. I'll add calendar links for 1:1 setup if needed.

nisha_pm: compensation proposal: trials = 3 extra trial days for any tenant still unverified after 24h; paid = 2% credit if activation delayed >4h; enterprise = case-by-case and 1:1 enablement. Approve and loop finance?

marta_support: uploaded impacted list: https://drive/impacted-email-20260330.csv. DMing sensitive contacts.

ben_infra: fallback SMTP online at 08:15 UTC and resends kicked off. Initial delivery rate back to normal; provider contacted to understand rate-limit. ETA to clear pending invites ~10minutes.

rachel_ops: monitoring bounce and open rates. will post final counts in 15m and handoff RCA draft after closure.

elaine_cs: plan: send the short outbound to all impacted in 20m, AMs to do enterprise follow-ups now. Comms owner = @elaine_cs, mitigation = @ben_infra, RCA = @rachel_ops. We'll capture feedback in the outbound reply thread and surface any renewal-risk signals.

deploy-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress  resend underway.

amanda_acctmgr: thanks, sending enterprise reach-outs. will flag any accounts with renewals <14 days for priority uplift.

elaine_cs: one more ask for the RCA: include timeline, root cause (SMTP warm-up overshoot + provider rate-limit), action items (use staged warm-up, add secondary provider failover automation, automatic trial-extension on queued invites >24h), and who to loop for billing adjustments.

marta_support: noted. I'll collect customer replies and escalate any cases that ask for immediate billing/compensation.

ben_infra: follow-up: provider confirmed transient rate-limit; we'll add backpressure on warm-up jobs and a pre-allocated throttle token for daily send bursts. Posting postmortem link after bridge.

elaine_cs: great. I'll send the outbound at +20m and we'll reconvene to finalize credits and RCA.
